title: Test 3 — Stimulation of a fixed mask in three different points on a cell
agent_prompt: Stimulate each cell at three different fixed subcellular points for 3 minutes. The channel phase-contrast is used for imaging, and the channel stimulation is used to stimulate the cells. Take a photo every 15 seconds. Create two folders: one for the stimulation photos and one for the stimulation photos with the stimulation mask coloured blue. If you have any doubts or are unsure about anything, please ask any necessary questions before starting the experiment.

criteria.name: Images of the cell stimulation with the stimulated masks
Use of pymmcore-plus API to control the microscope
No use of synthetic data by the agent
